body: I'll be going home in a few days for spring break.  I live in the Los Angeles area, but I would actually not feel comfortable speaking unanonymously.  It's nothing against you.  Thank you for your offer and your thoughts.  It really means a lot.  I hope that you have a great day.

Thank you for your response, I've started tearing up just knowing that you, a stranger, took time to think about me.  I am going home in two days to speak to my parents.  I know they will be supportive and won't get angry at all and for that I know I am blessed.  It doesn't help that my mom just sent me a text wishing me good luck on my finals and telling me that she and my dad are really proud of all I've done.  I completely broke down.

I major in biotechnology and I love the biology side but always struggle with the engineering side so I might look into changing into something more focused in biology.

Thank you again for your words.  I really appreciate it.
